description: This is a Java test class for PermissionRequestHelper, testing permission rationale, permission strings for contacts and notifications, and permission checks across different Android SDK versions.

classes.name: PermissionRequestHelperTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for PermissionRequestHelper, testing permission rationale, permission strings, and permission checks.

methods.name: testGetRationale
methods.description: Tests that the correct rationale string resource IDs are returned for contact and notification permissions.

methods.name: testGetPermissionsStringsContacts
methods.description: Tests that the correct permission string array for contacts is returned.

methods.name: testGetPermissionsStringsNotificationsOldDevice
methods.description: Tests permission strings for notifications on an older device SDK version.

methods.name: testGetPermissionsStringsNotificationsNewDevice
methods.description: Tests permission strings for notifications on a newer device SDK version.

methods.name: testCheckAlreadyHasPermissionsBeforeM
methods.description: Checks that permissions are already granted on devices with SDK version below M.

methods.name: testCheckAlreadyHasPermissionsWithM
methods.description: Checks that permissions are granted on devices with SDK version M and above.
